post.description:
Edits listings. Also use it to add new sizes.
The listing is overwritten when updated. So the request must also include those listing parameters that you are not going to update. To get their values, use Listings and Listings in Trash.
When the Listing is updated, the documents object is also completely overwritten. In the request, send the all documents data that should remain in the listing, including documents without changes.
You cannot use this method to update or delete: - item size SKUs. You can only add additional SKUs - the `photos`, `video` and `tags` parameters - prices of items. The price can only be set if you add new sizes When adding a new size, specify its price using the `price` parameter. If no `price` is specified in the request, the size price will be `0`. In this case, you can update it using the methods: - [Set Prices and Discounts](/openapi/item-management#tag/pricesAndDiscounts/operation/postV2UploadTask), if [item](/openapi/item-management#tag/pricesAndDiscounts/operation/getV2ListGoodsFilter) has `"editablePriceSize":false` - [Set Size Prices](/openapi/item-management#tag/pricesAndDiscounts/operation/postV2UploadTaskSize), if [item](/openapi/item-management#tag/pricesAndDiscounts/operation/getV2ListGoodsFilter) has `"editablePriceSize":true` The dimensions of the items can only be specified in `centimeters`, and the weight of packed items must be specified in `kilograms`.

If this method response is Success (`200`) but listing was not updated, check errors using [failed listings with errors](/openapi/item-management#tag/listings/operation/postV2CardsErrorList) method.
With one request you can edit maximum 3000 listings (`nmID`). Maximum request size is 10 Mb.
The process of synchronizing data with services may take up to 30 minutes. During this time, you can't add inventory to warehouses and set prices. To add documents to the listing, pass the document data in the `documents` request object.
To update the added document, pass document ID `id` and data in the `documents` request object. To get the `id` use [listings](/item-management#tag/listings/operation/postV2GetCardsList) method. When the listing or document is changed, the validation is started again.

Document validation is performed asynchronously and can take up to 3 days.
You can update the listing again before completing the current validation. In this case, the validation will be started again, and the listing will retain its current status until the new validation is completed.
If the listing was available for sale before the document was updated, it will be available until a new validation result is received. If the card has already been blocked, then after updating the data, it will remain blocked until a positive result of repeated validation is received.

The validation results are displayed in the [listings](/openapi/item-management#tag/listings/operation/postV2GetCardsList), the `documents` object: - the result for each document in the `verdict` fields of the `items` object. If `verdict` is not returned in the response, the document validation is not completed yet. - the final overall result for the listing in the `overallVerdict` field. During the listing validation, not only the results of the document validation are taken into account, but also other data. For example, the data of required labeling codes and information from external registries. If `overallVerdict` is not returned in the response, the listing validation is not completed yet.
The types of documents that you can add for the item are specified in subcategory characteristics.
Not all the documents that you can add are required and are being validated. You independently determine which permits are required for the item in accordance with the law.

maxCount.description:
The maximum number of values that can be assigned to a characteristic when [creating](./item-management#tag/listingItems) or [editing](./item-management#tag/listings/operation/postV2CardsUpdate) listings.
Used only for characteristics with `"charcType":1` — array of strings.
For characteristics with `"charcType":4` — number, you can assign only one value.

For characteristics with `"maxCount":0`, the number of values is unlimited.

charcType.description:

  -  `4` — number

isVariable.description:

  - `true` — item variations differ by this characteristic
  - `false` — item variations do not differ by this characteristic

post.description:
The method uploads a set of media files to a listing by specifying links in the request.
New media files (data) replace old ones (mediaFiles). To add new files, set links both to new and old files.
Requirements for links: * no authorization is required to access the file via the link * the link must point directly to the file. Ensure the link does not lead to a preview or authentication page. The link must end with the file name including its extension — for example, `/file_name.jpg`. If the link opens a TXT or HTML page, it is considered invalid.
Note that some storage services do not generate direct links and therefore are not suitable for use. **Google Drive** is an example of such a service, as it only generates links to a file preview or internal service pages. Requirements for images: * maximum images for each listing — 30 * minimal resolution – 700 × 900 pixels * maximum size — 32 MB * minimal quality — 65% * formats — JPG, PNG, BMP, GIF (static), WebP Requirements for video: * maximum one video for each listing * maximum size — 50 MB * formats — MOV, MP4 If one or several images or a video do not meet the requirements, no images and a video will be uploaded even if you have the success response (`200`)
